recorded_differences.description: The epoch validation loss (the early-stopping and checkpoint monitor) is the mean of the per-slide -log softmax[label]. The original stacks the per-slide float32 logs and sums and divides in float32 (utils/utils.py:cross_entropy_torch, logged by models/model_interface.py:validation_epoch_end); WSIP's shared evaluator averages the per-slide float32 losses in float64 (wsip/evaluation/evaluator.py:39). The per-slide losses are identical; only the final rounding of the mean differs.
recorded_differences.reason: The aggregation lives in the shared evaluator, not in the TransMIL adapter; changing it would change CLAM's validation loss. Whether to add an opt-in float32 aggregation is a framework decision (validation_loss_aggregation).
